description: This file implements the HostServer class for managing a host-side UI session, handling message passing, user input events, and session state transitions within the confui component of the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: HostServer
classes.description: Manages the host-side UI session, message handling, and state transitions for confui.

methods.name: HostServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HostServer with control, renderer, and communication pipes.

methods.name: IsVirtioConsoleOpen
methods.description: Checks if the virtio console communication channels are open.

methods.name: CheckVirtioConsole
methods.description: Verifies the virtio console is open, logs fatal error if not.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the host server, launching input fetcher and main loop threads.

methods.name: HalCmdFetcherLoop
methods.description: Continuously fetches commands from the HAL, wrapping messages with security flags.

methods.name: SendUserSelection
methods.description: Sends user-generated input messages into the session queue.

methods.name: TouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input events, creating and sending touch messages.

methods.name: UserAbortEvent
methods.description: Handles user abort events, creating and sending abort messages.

methods.name: MainLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing incoming messages and managing session state transitions.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new session object with a given name.

methods.name: IsUserAbort
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates a user abort response.

methods.name: Transition
methods.description: Handles state transition logic based on input messages.
